- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 23:18
- [EVENT] User is thinking of getting a new digital piano.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering a Yamaha P-125 or a Kawai ES110.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yamaha P-125 features: Price around $499 - $599, Graded Hammer Standard (GHS) weighted action, Pure CF Sound Engine, 192 notes polyphony, 24 built-in sounds, 20 built-in rhythms, 1-track recording, USB-to-host connectivity, weight 26 lbs, dimensions 52.3" x 11.6" x 29.9".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kawai ES110 features: Price around $699 - $799, Responsive Hammer Compact Action (RH-C) weighted action, Harmonic Imaging XL sound technology, 192 notes polyphony, 15 built-in sounds, 100 built-in rhythms, 3-track recording, USB-to-host connectivity, weight 33.5 lbs, dimensions 54.3" x 15.1" x 30.2".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Key differences between Yamaha P-125 and Kawai ES110: Price, action quality, sound technology, tones and rhythms, recording capabilities, weight, and dimensions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considerations for decision-making: budget, action responsiveness, sound quality, and recording capabilities.
- [PREFERENCE] User values the compact size of the Yamaha P-125 due to limited space at home.
